title: rl.CloseAudioDevice() deleted with no seam wrapper; audio_destroy no longer closes the device its comment still claims to close
detail: The seam wraps 17 raudio calls but CloseAudioDevice was simply deleted, not wrapped. Normal builds now never close the audio device at teardown, and the proc's comment still claims it does.
recommended_fix: Add audio_close_device to both seam branches and call it unconditionally from audio_destroy; or restore rl.CloseAudioDevice() in the else path and correct the comment.

title: Gallery retry budget (N11 / GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES) claimed but never implemented; retries field is dead
evidence:
+	retries:  int, // N11: the condition-poll frame budget (GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES)
...
+	case .Noc:
+		if !app.overlay_on || !app.stats_valid {
+			fmt.printfln("gallery: noc wait — overlay_on=%v stats_valid=%v mode=%v tick=%d terminal=%v", app.overlay_on, app.stats_valid, app.mode, app.tick, app.state.terminal)
+			gallery.wait = 5
+			return false
+		}
detail: Gallery.retries is declared with a comment naming GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES, but no hunk defines that constant or ever reads/increments retries; every condition poll retries every 5 frames forever.
recommended_fix: Implement the budget: increment retries in each wait branch and bail out (log + done) at GALLERY_MAX_RETRIES; or delete the field and its comment.

title: EndDrawing 'explicit flush' restructure is a when/else with identical branches and a false 'Release builds carry nothing' comment
detail: Both branches call rl.EndDrawing() identically; the comment 'Release builds carry nothing' is false — release carries the same call. The claimed screenshot-order fix is a semantic no-op.
recommended_fix: Collapse to a single unconditional rl.EndDrawing() and drop the misleading comment, or make the branches actually differ if a real difference was intended.

+	// rows need the real UTF-8 encoding to reach the atlas).
...

+		append(&cbuf, b)
+	}
...

detail: New harness file repeats the old mojibake rationale, but view.odin's draw_text_font in this same diff copies raw UTF-8 bytes, and crisis.odin's comments were updated accordingly.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the draw_specimen comment: the game helper is UTF-8-safe since the overhaul; draw_row exists only because the harness holds raw rl.Font handles.

evidence:

detail: view.odin deletes load_hud_font in this diff, yet the new verb cites it. The actual load (default codepoints, no fallback merge) also differs from the new load_font_file recipe.
recommended_fix: Update the comment to reference load_font_file / font_atlas_build_from_file and note the candidate intentionally loads without the fallback merge.

title: PP_SW_AUDIO's claimed producer documentation does not exist: gallery.odin never mentions the define
evidence:

+	// device_on); without it they are the plain raylib calls. The define's

title: audio_flush replacement lines misindented (extra tab) in all four play loops
detail: The four audio_play_sound replacements sit one indent level deeper than the lines they replaced and their surrounding loops; cosmetic but inconsistent within the same hunk.
recommended_fix: Re-indent the four calls to match the loop bodies.

title: noc_row's hierarchy-ladder comment still documents '>= 14 body, 10 labels' after the size bump
detail: The overhaul moves NOC section labels to 12px, sub-labels to 13px, and body rows to 15px, but the unchanged comment above noc_row still states the old 14/10 ladder.
recommended_fix: Update the comment to the new ladder (15 body, 12-13 labels).

title: Candidate font swap replaces only the body font; headers and NOC digits stay Plex in the A/B captures
evidence:
+	if rl.IsFontValid(f) {
+		rl.SetTextureFilter(f.texture, .BILINEAR)
+		app.view.font = f
...
+	old_font := rc.view.font
+	rc.view.font = f
+	defer rc.view.font = old_font
detail: Only view.font is swapped; font_header and font_mono remain shipped Plex, so candidate frames mix families in the very captures that drove the user's family pick.
recommended_fix: Swap all three font slots with the candidate (or load it into header/mono) for family-pure A/B frames; at minimum disclose the mixed rendering in the PR body.
